title: 里昂证券梁：AI收入爆发，云业务成亮点？
speaker: Eleanor Leung

segments.en: Right, I think this year is a very challenging year for the China Internet space because of the weak China macro as well as the AI disruption, so that's why we see this stock kind of
segments.zh: 我认为今年对中国互联网行业来说是非常具有挑战性的一年，因为中国宏观环境疲软以及AI的颠覆，所以我们看到这只权益资产今年表现不佳

segments.en: underperforming this year, but on the other hand, we see some exciting emerging AI revenue opportunity, especially with Baba Cloud, which is a big beat in the last quarter of results.
segments.zh: 但另一方面，我们看到一些令人兴奋的新兴AI收入机会，尤其是阿里云，上一季度业绩大幅超预期。

segments.en: We see that Cloud revenue is salary to 64% year and year and the AI related product continue to grow at a triple digit for the 13 consecutive quarters, and now it's contributing
segments.zh: 我们看到云收入同比增长64%，AI相关产品连续13个季度保持三位数增长，现在已贡献

segments.en: to over 35% of the total cloud revenue.
And their mass revenue also increased to 20 billion RMB ARR from basically nothing from the beginning of the years.
segments.zh: 他们的云业务收入也从年初的几乎为零增长到200亿元人民币的年度经常性收入。

segments.en: And their application, AI application revenue is also growing over 50%.
segments.zh: 他们的AI应用收入也增长了超过50%。

segments.en: On top of that, their margin is also improved to 14.5%, which is up like 4% each point year and year.
segments.zh: 此外，他们的利润率也提升至14.5%，同比提高了约4个百分点。

segments.en: So it's not just growing the top line, but also the margin.
segments.zh: 所以不仅仅是营收增长，利润率也在提升。

segments.en: So we see a very exciting opportunity there.
segments.zh: 所以我们看到了非常令人兴奋的机会。
